plan.title: eRFX Technical T&C Required Clause Blocking

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory project title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one item for the event.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Add one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event was published successfully.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier portal session.
Open the event's Technical stage as the vendor.
Confirm the required Technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Confirm the optional Technical-stage clause is shown to the vendor.
Complete the technical questionnaire so the vendor can attempt submission.
Accept only the optional clause.
Attempt submission while the required clause remains unchecked.
Verify submission is blocked and the required clause is identified.
Accept the required clause after the blocked attempt.
Resubmit the completed Technical response.
Confirm the Technical submission succeeds after accepting the required clause.
Open the RFQ stage as the vendor.
Verify the Technical-stage clauses are not requested on the RFQ stage.
